role: Strategy-owned named-contract position ledger used before portfolio aggregation. Each strategy sees only its own book; the formal account sees the aggregate of all books.
invariants: a strategy book owns only real named OIL-YYMM futures positions and never a synthetic spread security
a strategy decision may consume only its own strategy book positions; aggregate formal-account positions are not a valid substitute
portfolio aggregation sums books by named contract without changing strategy-level ownership
two strategies may hold opposite positions in the same named contract even when the aggregate account nets them
book aggregation never creates fills, pnl, margin credits or market write-back
one institution cannot aggregate a book owned by another institution
book identity is deterministic for the same institution, strategy and positions
